build_rms_layer_norm: build an RMS Layer Normalization module for a given model dimension with optional device and dtype
build_fp32_layer_norm: build a single-precision Layer Normalization module for a given model dimension with optional device and dtype
build_unit_layer_norm: build a StandardLayerNorm without learnable mean and variance for a given model dimension
parse_layer_norm_factory: parse a layer normalization style string and return the corresponding LayerNormFactory function
review_FP32LayerNorm_forward: review the FP32LayerNorm forward method that casts inputs and params to float32 before normalization
